personality_one_liner: A structural, playful, and high-contrast fitness game where every component feels like a tactile, coded object.

spacing.rule: Use rigid, boxy spacing. Avoid floating elements; everything should sit in a defined container.

icon_set: custom (1.6px strokes, rounded caps, no fill)

dont's: Do not use blur, glass, or soft shadows. All shadows must be hard 0 2px 0 offsets.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Entry point with logo, SVG character, and Google login.
screens.layout: Center aligned. Oversized typography for logo. SVG character in the middle. Primary Google CTA at the bottom thumb zone with hard offset shadow.

screens.name: NameAndColor
screens.purpose: Onboarding step to pick name and 6 colors with live character preview.

states.error: Validation error if name is empty

screens.layout: Live SVG character preview on top. Name input field below it. 6 color choice chips wrapped in a row. Sticky 'Continue' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: HealthPermission

states.error: Permission denied state with deep amber warning

screens.layout: Large icon or SVG illustration at top. Bold headline (Bricolage). Body text (Inter) explaining why. Primary CTA to allow, secondary text link to skip.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main dashboard showing character stage, today's steps, and progress.

states.empty: New user state: welcome message instead of stats
states.error: Failed to fetch steps: retry button

screens.layout: Top portion: Character stage with dark backdrop (Занар) radius 28. SVG character inside. Below: thick-bordered cards for today's steps (with progress bar using Хаш), yesterday/7 days summary, and weight line position. JetBrains Mono for all numeric data.

screens.name: Journal
screens.purpose: Historical step data and weight curve.

states.empty: No data yet message with empty state illustration
states.error: Failed to load history: retry CTA

screens.layout: 7-day bar chart card. Yesterday vs Today comparison block. 30-day weight curve graph. High contrast, thick 1.5px lines for charts.

screens.name: Groups
screens.purpose: List of user's groups with their weight axis.

states.error: Failed to load groups: retry CTA

screens.layout: Scrollable list of group cards. Each card has a mini horizontal weight axis showing members. Floating Action Button (or sticky bottom row) for Create/Join.

screens.name: GroupDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a group's members on a shared weight axis.

states.error: Failed to load members: retry CTA

screens.layout: Top half: Full horizontal weight axis (Хөнгөн → Хүнд) with SVG avatars positioned by weight. Bottom half: Scrollable list of members' today steps. Invite button.

screens.name: JoinByCode
screens.purpose: 6-cell input to join a private group.
screens.layout: Large 6-cell mono-spaced input boxes (JetBrains Mono). Group name preview card appears below when valid. Sticky 'Join' CTA.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: List of thick-bordered rows. Name, color picker, daily goal input, notification toggles. Logout and Delete account buttons in warning colors (Хув) at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color palette: Овъёос (main bg), Бэх (text/lines/borders), Хаш (primary action), Хув (warnings), Ультра (social), Занар (dark stage).
Typography must strictly use Bricolage Grotesque 700 for Display, Inter for Body, and JetBrains Mono for numeric/data displays.
Implement the brutalist box model: 1.5px solid borders, hard offset shadows (0 2px 0) in ink color (or border color in dark mode), and NO blurred shadows or glassmorphism.
Buttons must have a press-shrink to 0.96 animation and eliminate the offset shadow on press to simulate physical clicking.

The character must be implemented entirely using react-native-svg. Body width, height, eye spacing, mouth curve, and color (shifting from Хаш to Хув) must interpolate based on a single weight variable (0-100).
Group screens must feature a horizontal axis (Хөнгөн → Хүнд) where members are placed relative to their weight variable.
All text must be in Mongolian sentence case as requested.
Dark mode is mandatory. Use Занар (#232B25) for backgrounds and ensure border/shadow colors invert cleanly for visibility.
Implement 6-cell code input for the 'Join by code' screen using JetBrains Mono.
